protocol.name: stopwatch.dsh.native-approval.v1
protocol.requestId: ApprovalService callback requestId; service-minted UUID, identical to approval/asked and approval/decided id

scopeFields.arguments: complete deeply immutable detached body input snapshot
scopeFields.standingPolicy: complete captured effective policy before approval
scopeFields.execution: complete resolved foreground shell spec excluding dshEnv and signal; includes command, absolute workdir, timeoutMs, onExpiry, stdoutMaxBytes and requested sandboxPolicy

protocol.authority: trusted pinned ordinary Bash composition; no attestation against malicious in-process plugins
protocol.eligibility: ordinary foreground Bash, no job registry/promotion, complete resolved absolute workdir/positive timeout/stdout budget/kill expiry; adapter must independently require fully displayable exact scope; unknown resolved executor fields (including explicit env/stdin) omit descriptor
protocol.environment: dshEnv captured/reused privately before approval and excluded from public descriptor; ambient process environment is outside command-scope protocol
protocol.outcomes: only committed matching approval/decided is authoritative; allowed-once and rejected only actionable choices

dependencyTree.algorithm: sha256(sorted(relative POSIX path + NUL + lowercase file SHA256 + LF)); regular files only; no symlinks
